Yes, you can request to cancel an order after placing it, but whether we can do it depends on the order status when we reply to your message.

If the order hasn’t shipped yet: We can cancel it.
If it’s already shipped: We’ll try to intercept it, but success isn’t guaranteed.

Please contact us as soon as you decide to cancel so we can review your case.
